description.value: Fezziwig's is a Kelowna institution that has been baking all its bread fresh on-site every morning since 2006, using locally sourced and organic ingredients where possible. Named after the warm-hearted Dickens character, the cafe offers hearty home-style breakfasts and a generous sandwich menu, alongside Cherry Hill Coffee — a local, organic, fair-trade roaster. This Guisachan Village Centre location is one of three around Kelowna, making it a reliable mid-ride stop in the city's south end.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM phone number (+1 250 861 1888) matches the Guisachan Village Centre branch listed on the website (101 – 2365 Gordon Drive), confirming this record represents that specific location of the three-branch chain. The website's About page explicitly states 'Guisachan Village Centre (WiFi available)', confirming Wi-Fi at this location. Takeout is confirmed by 'Takeaway sandwiches come with bag of Kettle Chips but no garnish', and vegetarian/GF options are explicitly listed across the menu and catering pages.
concerns: OSM record has no address field; address derived from website by matching OSM phone number to the Guisachan Village Centre branch (101 – 2365 Gordon Drive).
This is one of three locations; the other two (Mission Park Shopping Centre and Okanagan College) have separate phone numbers and are not represented in this OSM record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, multi-location bakery-cafe with a live website (copyright 2026), confirmed phone match, and food/drink offerings directly useful to touring cyclists.
